item.title: Drake’s ‘ICEMAN’ No. 1 for Fourth Week on Billboard 200
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest update on the Billboard charts. We've got some exciting news to share with you today. Drake's album 'ICEMAN' is still chilling at the top of the Billboard 200 chart, marking its fourth week at number one. Let's dive into the details."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to Luminate, 'ICEMAN' earned 133,000 equivalent album units in the United States in the week ending June 11. This is a 22% drop from the previous week, but still enough to keep it at the top spot. In fact, 'ICEMAN' is the first album to spend its first four weeks at number one since Taylor Swift's 'The Life of a Showgirl' did the same in 2025."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake is no stranger to the top of the charts, with 15 number one albums under his belt. But 'ICEMAN' is only the fourth of his albums to spend more than four weeks at number one. His album 'Views' still holds the record with 13 weeks at number one back in 2016."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But 'ICEMAN' isn't the only newsmaker on the Billboard 200 chart this week. Malcolm Todd is making his top 10 debut with his album 'Do That Again', coming in at number five. And Niall Horan is back in the top 10 with his new album 'Dinner Party', landing at number seven."
[Short music transition]
Host: "We'll be keeping an eye on the Billboard charts, and we'll have the full June 20th chart posted on the Billboard website on June 16th. Follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media for all the latest chart news. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music plays]
